tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background (blue) behind every content card, right of the sidebar. Text placed directly on it uses on-canvas or on-canvas-muted, never ink or muted.

tokens.name: on-canvas
tokens.usage: Page titles and any text or icon placed directly on canvas (7.4:1). Also the focus ring on canvas.

tokens.name: on-canvas-muted
tokens.usage: Page subtitles and footer text directly on canvas (5.3:1).

tokens.name: canvas-rule
tokens.usage: Footer divider line on canvas. Decorative only.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, form cards, modals, top bar, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table header row, input add-ons (฿, %), disabled inputs.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Table row hover, menu item hover, ghost button hover.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card edges, table row dividers, top bar bottom edge, footer rule.

tokens.name: border-input
tokens.usage: Input, select and textarea borders at rest (3.1:1 on surface).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, page titles, KPI values, table cell primary text on surface and canvas.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Body copy and secondary table cells on surface and canvas.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Captions, table header labels, helper text on surface and surface-sunken (5.3:1+). On canvas use on-canvas-muted.

tokens.name: placeholder
tokens.usage: Input placeholder text on surface only (4.8:1).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: LTS Navy. Primary buttons, links, active tab underline, selected checkbox, chart Sales series. White text on it.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and pressed.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Selected table row, active pagination page, soft navy KPI tile. Text on it: primary.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary and primary-hover.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Gold accent. POS button fill, active sidebar indicator, chart Purchases series, gold KPI tile. Text on it: on-gold, never white.

tokens.name: gold-hover
tokens.usage: Gold button hover.

tokens.name: gold-soft
tokens.usage: Soft gold KPI tile and gold highlights. Text on it: gold-text.

tokens.name: gold-text
tokens.usage: Gold-toned text on surface and gold-soft (5.5:1+).

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and icons on gold (8:1).

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Teal KPI tile fill (returns). White text on it.

tokens.name: teal-soft
tokens.usage: Soft teal KPI tile. Text on it: teal-text.

tokens.name: teal-text
tokens.usage: Teal text on teal-soft.

tokens.name: rose
tokens.usage: Rose KPI tile fill (expenses). White text on it.

tokens.name: rose-soft
tokens.usage: Soft rose KPI tile. Text on it: rose-text.

tokens.name: rose-text
tokens.usage: Rose text on rose-soft.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Solid success fill and success icons. White text on it.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of Paid / Completed badges and success notices.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Text on success-soft.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Solid warning icons and dots (icons only, 3:1+).

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of Pending / Partial badges and low-stock notices.

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Text on warning-soft.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Danger buttons, delete icons, required-field asterisk, error borders. White text on it.

tokens.name: danger-hover
tokens.usage: Danger button hover.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of Unpaid / Out of stock badges and error notices.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Text on danger-soft and inline error messages on surface.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Solid info icons and dots.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background of Received / Ordered badges and info notices.

tokens.name: info-text
tokens.usage: Text on info-soft.

tokens.name: neutral-soft
tokens.usage: Background of neutral badges (Draft, piece units, codes).

tokens.name: neutral-text
tokens.usage: Text on neutral-soft.

tokens.name: sidebar-bg
tokens.usage: Sidebar background, the deep navy rail.

tokens.name: sidebar-raised
tokens.usage: Active and hovered sidebar item fill.

tokens.name: sidebar-text
tokens.usage: Sidebar item labels and icons on sidebar-bg (10:1).

tokens.name: sidebar-muted
tokens.usage: Sidebar group labels and chevrons on sidebar-bg (5.9:1).

tokens.name: sidebar-active
tokens.usage: Active sidebar item label on sidebar-raised.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid with 2px offset, on surface and canvas (4.4:1+). Inside the sidebar the ring is gold.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind modals.
